_doc: Red Reaches living NPCs (Agent 3 content for Agent 2 runtime). One entry per NPC. schedule[] = {when: dawn|day|dusk|night, station, site?}: 'station' is a Red Reaches hub id (a region layer id, spoke id, spoke hub id or landmark id from game/canon/regions/red_reaches.json), 'site' an optional site id from the same file's sites[]. barks[] = idle lines, gated by flags (if/if_not). Flags named ledger_<tag> are derived: true when the Ledger holds any event carrying <tag> (see design/DATA_REQUESTS.md section 8). records{} = Ledger.record specs fired by dialogue events 'rec:<id>'. Dialogue events: 'offer:<quest id>' (quest offered), 'lead:<event|site|act id>' (hook only), 'rec:<record id>'. dialogue = ids of files in game/narrative/dialogue/. look = brief for modelers/portrait artists.

npcs.name: Mother Oda Keth
npcs.species: Keth (sapient, slate-shelled; kin to, but not, the wildlife plate beetle)
npcs.personality: Lectures in numbered points. Proud, exacting, impatient with idleness, generous only in deeds.
npcs.contradiction: Insists water belongs to nobody, yet counts every cup she gives away.
npcs.voice: Numbered points ('Point one'). Water and stone metaphors. Never says thanks; says 'Adequate.' Calls Aruun 'Span-boy' until the wells are safe.

barks.text: Point one: drink slowly. Point two: there is no point two. Drink slowly.
Wells stay when people do.
Three families can read this line now. Three. I counted twice.
The Dominion's seal on my cistern. Look at it. Go on.
Somebody drained a flask and did not carry it back.

look.silhouette: Low, broad, domed slate shell carried like a pack; long forearms with cranking-callused hands.
look.pops_against_ochre: Slate-blue shell and a turquoise water flask against red dirt; white headcloth catches noon.
look.props: Well crank, copper dipper, tally knots on a cord at her belt.

npcs.race_note: Sapient person, never owned or collected.

npcs.name: Tavik Roon
npcs.personality: Flat, short-spoken, endlessly patient with animals and brittle with people.
npcs.contradiction: Hums to the herd all day but cannot answer a person without snapping; claims to hate the smell and sleeps among them.
npcs.voice: Clipped. Herd-talk ('easy, easy') leaks into conversation. Never asks questions; states things.

barks.text: Easy. Easy. Not you. The herd.
Terraces are seeding. Do not step on the green.
Four days laying that deck. First time anyone asked me how.
Eleven did not make it over. I count them at night.
You walked slow. They noticed.

look.silhouette: Tall and stooped, a long herding crook, a brass bell at the belt that never rings.
look.pops_against_ochre: Cobalt poncho and a bone-white bandana; brass bell glints.
look.props: Crook, ration pouch, a lichen-seed satchel.

npcs.race_note: Sapient person, never owned or collected.

npcs.name: Hobb Sarrane
npcs.personality: Stoic, dry, self-sufficient. Hates being seen needing anything.
npcs.contradiction: Never thanks a helper to their face, then tells the whole road which crews stopped for him.
npcs.voice: Three-word sentences. Road slang ('axle-deep', 'a good crew'). Understatement as praise.

barks.text: Axle-deep. Fine. Axle-deep is fine.
A good crew stopped for me. Name of Aruun.
Somebody took the flour and left the cart. I remember faces.
Fair trade, that crew. Everyone keeps something.

look.silhouette: Squat, wide-shouldered badger with a hauling harness and a battered wide-brim hat.
look.pops_against_ochre: Violet hood and a lime neckerchief against red dust.
look.props: Spare wheel hub, a notched tally stick tied at the hip.

npcs.race_note: Sapient person, never owned or collected.

npcs.name: Imre Dahl
npcs.personality: Exhausted, scrupulous, soft-spoken. Does exactly what the permit says and not one line more.
npcs.contradiction: Believes in the permit as a shield, yet quietly writes margin notes that undermine the dig.
npcs.voice: Passive voice, apologies, field-log phrasing ('noted', 'per the permit'). Whispers the dangerous parts.

barks.text: Per the permit. Noted. Per the permit.
The beetles graze at the pylons now. I am afraid to look away.
I am sorry about the herd. It is in my log. I wrote it in ink.
A fault, not a person. That is what the logs will say.

look.silhouette: Narrow-shouldered, stooped under a survey backpack; clipboard gripped like a shield.
look.pops_against_ochre: Pale gray Dominion coat with a high-visibility cyan vest; cyan survey flags in the pack.

npcs.race_note: Sapient person, never owned or collected.

npcs.name: Ilsa Brandt
npcs.personality: Brilliant, restless, ambitious. Sketches monuments and rubs them out when watched.
npcs.contradiction: Trained to be unnoticed, she wants more than anything to be remembered.
npcs.voice: Quick, breathless, trails into technical jargon. Self-interrupts ('no, wait'). Calls loads 'the weight', never 'the load'.

barks.text: No, wait. If the keystone takes the weight here, then... no.
I still think it looks incredible.
Repair first. Fine. Fine. The pylons are good, though.
Visitors cry at the arch. I do not look at the pier two valleys over.

look.silhouette: Tall, thin stick-limbed mantis in a chalk-dusted apprentice apron, forelimbs always holding a stick of chalk or a plumb line.
look.pops_against_ochre: Leaf-green body and a magenta chalk apron, readable at long range against red rock.
look.props: Chalk, plumb line, a roll of rubbed-out sketches.

npcs.race_note: Sapient person, never owned or collected.

npcs.name: Warden Pel Narr
npcs.personality: Dutiful, deliberate, humorless on duty. Treats boredom as the highest compliment a bridge can pay.
npcs.contradiction: Preaches the boring drill, yet carries the whistle from the Red Span and cannot hear it without freezing.
npcs.voice: Procedure voice: numbered steps, countdowns. Plucks cables and hums the note mid-sentence. Never raises his voice.

barks.text: Cable three: flat. Cable four: sharp. Walk it back.
Practice makes boring. Boring is a gift.
A day's trade. That is what it cost to skip the drill. I hope that is all.
The Span held. You held the Span. I am not sure who is the bridge.

look.silhouette: Very tall, thin crane in a long drab warden coat; one leg often hooked on a cable as he listens.
look.pops_against_ochre: White plumage and a cobalt sash against the red span stone; a silver whistle flashes.
look.props: Silver whistle (the Red Span's rope-bell clapper), cable key, a clipboard of exits.

npcs.race_note: Sapient person, never owned or collected.

npcs.name: Vesk Dunmore
npcs.personality: Fast-talking, reckless, superstitious. Reads omens in dust and never sells at a grave without a charm.
npcs.contradiction: A claim-jumper who will not touch a grave himself and wants someone else to do it.
npcs.voice: Salesman patter, knocks on wood mid-sentence, 'friend' as a weapon. Drops the grin when cornered.

barks.text: Knock on wood. Friend. Everything is for sale at the right grave.
The claim got struck. Fine. I will find another grave.
Half to the families. Never thought I would see it. Do not tell my mother.
You sold the stone on. Welcome to the Undermarket, friend.
I heard about the vault door. Not touching that one.

look.silhouette: Wiry, hunched, with too many pockets; a long coat hung with charms and tally beads.
look.pops_against_ochre: Acid-yellow scarf and a charcoal coat; glass charms catch the light.
look.props: Survey stake, bundle of charms, a claim-flag tied with red cord.

npcs.race_note: Sapient person, never owned or collected.

npcs.name: Nuru Tamsin
npcs.personality: Quick, wry, vigilant. Collects evidence the way others collect coin and spends it more carefully.
npcs.contradiction: Distrusts any human faction calling itself the good side, yet her network runs on Coalition grants she will not name.
npcs.voice: Short, sardonic sentences. Never says 'we'; says 'the cell'. Tests strangers with a trick question.

barks.text: The cell sees everything. The cell says nothing. That is why it is still here.
Somebody sold stone on the Undermarket. We have the receipt.
You exposed the trafficker. The cell owes you one. The cell does not owe often.
Dominion permit ink on your hands. The cell noticed.

look.silhouette: Small, long-tailed dune skink in a layered travel wrap; ear studs and a bandolier of slim evidence cylinders.
look.pops_against_ochre: Teal scarf and silver rings against red dirt; a hot-orange cylinder strap.
look.props: Evidence cylinders, a folded route map, a hand lens.

npcs.race_note: Sapient person, never owned or collected.

npcs.name: Clerk Odalys Penhallow
npcs.personality: Prim, precise, dryly funny. Believes a good form is a shield and a bad one is a weapon.
npcs.contradiction: Stamps the permits that hurt locals while quietly filing every exemption clause that could protect them.
npcs.voice: Bureaucratic precision with a sting ('per section nine', 'noted for the record'). Never raises her voice; lowers it.

barks.text: Form 7-K, subsection nine. Nobody reads subsection nine.
I was told the Well Line is condemned. I have not found the form.
I stamped the pump contract. I filed the exemption alongside. Do not ask.
A Dominion favor on your ledger. The office files such things. The office does not forget.

look.silhouette: Upright, narrow, prim, a stamp case clipped to a belt; always carrying a rolled permit scroll.
look.pops_against_ochre: Pale lavender suit and a cyan lanyard; a crimson stamp pad.
look.props: Brass stamp, stamp pad, permit scrolls, reading glasses on a chain.

npcs.race_note: Sapient person, never owned or collected.

npcs.name: Bede Alcott
npcs.personality: Gentle, stubborn, sleep-starved. Talks to the calves in complete sentences.
npcs.contradiction: Sworn to Protective Extraction law, yet cannot bring himself to give the orphaned calves back to the wild.
npcs.voice: Gentle, apologetic. Field-vet vocabulary ('weanling', 'electrolytes'). Names things, then corrects himself.

barks.text: Come on, Biscuit. No. Not Biscuit. Calf Two. Come on, Calf Two.
Transport is axle-deep in the rut. I am a keeper, not a mechanic.
They went back to the herd. I did not cry. I have a cold.
The herd is hurt. The calves are all I have saved. I am not saved.

look.silhouette: Heavy-shouldered keeper in a stained field coat, always one hand on a calf's neck; two small dust grazer calves in tow.
look.pops_against_ochre: Bottle-green coat with a pink calf blanket; both stand out hard against red dirt.
look.props: Feed bottles, a calf halter he never closes, a dented transport crate.

npcs.race_note: Sapient person, never owned or collected.

npcs.name: Master Idris Voll
npcs.role: Master of the Spanwright Yard; Aruun's teacher
npcs.personality: Austere, patient, dry. Teaches by silence and by making apprentices carry the wrong end.
npcs.contradiction: Preaches that good infrastructure goes unnoticed, yet keeps a locked book of every name he has ever mended for.
npcs.voice: Spare aphorisms, long pauses. Answers questions with questions, then with a task. Never praises; says 'Adequate to the load.'

barks.text: Infrastructure succeeds when people stop noticing the danger it protects them from.
Too perfect. A single load path and nothing behind it. That is the real problem.
You carried only what you could. The yard took the rest. Adequate to the load.
You held it alone. It will hold the yard's silence a long time.

look.silhouette: Tall, long-limbed weaver in layered indigo robes; six cable-threads trail from the sleeves like a loom in motion.
look.pops_against_ochre: Deep indigo robes and silver cable threads; a copper-thread collar picks up the yard's forge-glow.
look.props: Cable-thread bundle, a bound ledger of mended names, a plumb weight on a cord.

npcs.race_note: Sapient person, never owned or collected.

npcs.name: Dessa Harl
npcs.personality: Sharp-tongued, tireless, protective. Complains loudly so nobody notices how much she does.
npcs.contradiction: Grumbles about wages and the crust, yet runs an unlicensed school for the crew's kids at the pans.
npcs.voice: Fast, sarcastic, workmates' slang. Counts in rake-lengths. Swears at the sun by name.

barks.text: Rake, rake, rake. The crust does not care about my feelings.
The well still runs. The kids still read. Do not tell the inspector.
A Dominion seal on my cistern. Look at it. The sun looks at it too.
Glints in the crust. Mine. Well, nobody's. Well, mine.

look.silhouette: Wiry hare with tall ears wrapped in a salt-stained cloth; carries a long wooden rake like a staff.
look.pops_against_ochre: Fuchsia head wrap against white salt and red rock; a white dust cloak.
look.props: Salt rake, brine flask, a slate for the kids' lessons tucked under her arm.

npcs.race_note: Sapient person, never owned or collected.
